story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 12 — Sealwright Chamber / The Copying Attempts
scene_purpose: Let the four-person party investigate the protected Ancient sealwright chamber opened after the First Command Warden; discover recent practice work progressing from Ancient seals through older Yahtrean forms toward repeated copies of the Crest of Yahtrea; establish that the practitioner used unusually powerful magic while preserving the crucial distinction between copying the visible royal seal and reproducing its genuine magical authority response; then end the Old City field section and return directly to Caelora for Mirena's private debrief.

sections: Beat 12 — Sealwright Chamber / The Copying Attempts

scene_context_seed.location_name: protected Ancient Diysean sealwright chamber beyond the inert First Command Warden
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: The chamber is physical magical craft: stone worktables, fitted dies and matrices, engraving frames, seal rests, inlay channels, binding circles, presses, blanks, impressions, test media and magical scorching. The room contains recent or comparatively recent practice work among Ancient fixtures. Do not prescribe which character discovers each stage or the order of conversation. Let Person Agents investigate what is visible and argue from their own expertise. Cyanis owns questions about his own Card handling; do not assign Ilyra automatic Card custody, safety arbitration, or scene-closing authority. No new map or route relief exists in this beat.

hard_outcomes: The chamber is recognized as an Ancient Diysean sealwright / authority-craft workspace that has also been used recently or comparatively recently.
Physical practice evidence shows a progression from copied Ancient Diysean seals to older Yahtrean seals to seals from royal Yahtrean documents and finally repeated attempts at the Crest of Yahtrea.
The Crest of Yahtrea is treated as the visible Yahtrean royal seal, not as a separate unrelated symbol.
The later practice attempts show evidence of unusually powerful magical work and repeated failed or incomplete binding attempts.
The party establishes that reproducing the visible Crest is a different achievement from reproducing the genuine magical authority response carried by Lysara's working royal seal.
Nothing in the chamber proves any copied seal ever reproduced the genuine royal magical authority response.
The party knows of no established historical case proving a successful magical duplicate of the true Yahtrean royal seal response.
The practitioner remains unidentified and is not proven to be the recent reader, author of the Card transport orders, or someone who accessed Lysara's real seal.
Cyanis's Card remains stable deep Ruby with no further transformation, manifestation, Prime recovery or gameplay unlock.
No new map, route relief, unnamed site, northbound route discovery or geography-copying task appears in Beat 12.
The party concludes that the Old City investigation has produced evidence that now requires Crown records and Mirena / Lysara context in Caelora.
When the player leaves the chamber, the Old City field section ends immediately and the story cuts directly to Beat 13's private Caelora meeting with Mirena; there is no playable return traversal.
authority_override_note: Current character authorities and runtime brains are aligned: Cyanis is Crest Knight / Crest Magus; Nimera is Cardweaver / Proofhunter aligned to Memory; current Ilyra and Torren dialogue-assignment/progression guardrails apply directly. production_cost_ceiling: one bounded post-boss investigation space with a small number of authored stops, then immediate cut to Caelora on exit
